rationale.before: Control22 required an incomplete active wave to remain immutable but did not require integrator to prove each selected source path/blob exists and is reachable at the pinned selection snapshot before sealing. C23 therefore remained sealed even after five source references were independently shown unresolvable, blocking final comparator publication.
rationale.after: Control23/integrator config15 makes exact per-source path/blob reachability and pointer consistency a pre-seal and post-seal invariant. A mechanically proven source-invalid incomplete wave is quarantined and superseded under a new wave id after a fresh fully verified selection; it is never silently repaired in place or semantically interpreted.

rollback.condition: Restore control22 only if exact source preflight blocks a valid seal solely because the connector cannot verify references independently proven reachable. Preserve schema3 identity, feed losslessness, durable receipts, CLEAN isolation and O single-writer safety.
rollback.do_not_rollback_to: Guessed/stale source refs, same-wave source substitution, semantic interpretation of a source-invalid wave, fuzzy identity repair, or duplicate O writing.

exact_next_action: Inspect the first integrator config15 execution. If C23 is still current and source-invalid, require an immutable invalid-wave diagnostic and a new superseding ACTIVE_WAVE whose every source path/blob passes exact snapshot preflight and postwrite revalidation; no semantic integration of C23 is allowed.
Require o_novelty_comparator/evidence_comparator to stay diagnostic-only on C23 and resume semantic work only on the verified superseding wave.
Validate the next lossless O_FEED publication under control23 without weakening the staged-blob preservation contract.
Continue validating o_work_monitor_recovery config12 no-trigger lightweight reuse with zero semantic O reads and no O mutation.
